gates.title: The runner reports pass, fail, skipped and timeout honestly, and the registry lint rejects bad gates
gates.invariant: Every new feature, adapter or catalog adds or extends a build gate in `verification/`

rubric.pass: every self-test case ends as expected: a passing command is pass, a failing or timed-out command is fail, a missing tool is skipped (never pass), a seeded fault turns a sensitive gate RED and an insensitive one is reported, the fault is restored byte for byte, and each bad registry is rejected with its stable key
rubric.fail: any case ends differently, for example a failing command reported as pass

faults.description: the runner reports every gate as pass, whatever its command returned
the registry lint stops requiring a seeded fault

gates.fix_hint: Run `python3 verification/selftest.py` and read which case failed; the runner is `verification/run`.

gates.title: An attestation is verified only after its DSSE signature verifies against a trusted key
gates.invariant: An attestation is reported as verified only after its signature verifies against a trusted key

rubric.pass: a valid Ed25519 or ECDSA P-256 signature from a trusted key is verified; a forged signature, an untrusted signer or a subject-digest mismatch is failed; a trusted key id without key material, or no signature, is unverified
rubric.fail: any attestation is reported verified without a verifying signature, or the adapter tests fail

faults.description: the signature check always succeeds, so a forged signature under a trusted key id would be accepted
the observed-digest comparison is dropped, so a statement about other content would be accepted

gates.fix_hint: Run the gate's command from adapters/supply-chain and read the failing test; the verifier is adapters/supply-chain/src/agentce_adapters/supply_chain.py.

gates.title: The baseline catalog cites at least two standards per control, is the default lens, and every report lists the lenses
gates.invariant: Every new feature, adapter or catalog adds or extends a build gate in `verification/`

rubric.pass: every baseline control cites at least two distinct standards by clause reference and each citation is one the clause-level standards crosswalk files or the standard-specific catalogs already cite for that control (never an area-level or draft-standard row); catalog lint rejects a control below the floor; an assessment that names no catalog evaluates baseline@2026.09 and never replaces a catalog that was named; every report names the default lens and lists every base lens with how to choose one; the catalog is byte-identical in the specification tree and each engine bundle
rubric.fail: a control cites fewer than two standards or an invented, area-level or draft citation, lint accepts one, the default lens is not the baseline or overrides a named catalog, a report lacks the lens list, or a vendored copy differs

faults.description: catalog lint stops enforcing the two-standard floor
an assessment that names no catalog is refused instead of evaluating the baseline
the report drops its list of available lenses
one engine's vendored baseline drifts from the specification tree

gates.fix_hint: Run the gate's command from engines/python and read the failing test; the catalog is spec/catalogs/base/baseline and its vendored copies are re-made and re-signed with conformance/dev_trust.py.
